verdict.rationale: Appwrite's Auth docs explicitly claim it can track which signed-in users are active and broadcast online, typing, and viewing status in realtime. That covers both presence and ephemeral state between connected clients, backed by its realtime offering. The support rests on a single summary-level line, though. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the presence/ephemeral API (channels, payloads, limits), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track user presence and broadcast ephemeral state between connected clients

citations.quote: Track which signed-in users are active right now and broadcast online, typing, and viewing status in realtime.
Respond to server events in realtime.
